confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on aggregated Bangkok price sources from 2024 to 2026 (cost-of-living guides, expat price lists and venue menus), converted to USD at an assumed rate of about 33-36 THB per USD. The sources are crowd-sourced or estimated and their dates and methods differ, so treat them as ranges. Beer, coffee and inexpensive meal anchors are medium confidence. Cocktail and wine anchors are lower confidence: the sources mostly cover hotel bars and rooftops, so I took a midpoint that includes some non-tourist venues, and I checked them against the beer price. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Bangkok, not from any search or live listings. The three-course mid-range meal for two is the least certain food anchor, because one source gave an average near THB 1,239 while tourist-area restaurants typically cost more. The FX observation comes from a search result that quoted the RBA page; I did not open the RBA table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed for the food and drink anchors, which were based directly on Bangkok price data. Accommodation anchors reflect general knowledge of Bangkok's guesthouse, hostel and mid-range hotel market. Cocktail and wine anchors were checked against the beer anchor, since Bangkok bar prices run at a consistent multiple of local draft beer.
